target_format.intent: one of six existing router labels

metadata.provenance: Manually authored synthetic situations and paraphrases for this prototype. Not Avito policies, not real conversations, not model outputs. No seed or contract-fixture text was copied into test.
metadata.split_method: Situation families assigned to splits before paraphrases. No family_id crosses splits; no random row split. Family labels describe intended distinctions, not proof of semantic independence.
limitations: Pending analyst review; labels and family boundaries may change. Test is provisional, visible during preparation and not a frozen blind holdout.
One synthetic team and one supported resource; no evidence for cross-team generalization or backend ACL correctness.
Balanced small synthetic corpus with narrow subfamilies; shared scenario vocabulary and related meanings remain across splits. Manual semantic leakage review is required.
No training, evaluation, quality result or corpus acceptance is claimed by creating this file.
Intent is a recommendation, not authorization. Chat agreement never confirms a draft; only backend confirmation of a concrete version may submit.
No user_id, role, team identity, source text, operation IDs or confirmation flags are model inputs. Backend supplies actor context and enforces state independently.
Test explain_access in pending_approval and out_of_scope access requests are analyst-review boundary cases, not approved policy decisions.
